description:
## Fix

- **RuTube: "Custom branding icon" no longer fails (SEVERE).** Root cause was two bugs: RuTube switched its launcher icons from PNG to WebP, but the patch only ever looked for `.png`; and the bundled replacement icon assets the patch reads via `getResourceAsStream` never actually existed in this repo's `patches/src/main/resources/`. Added a hand-written WebP VP8L header parser alongside the existing PNG one, made the patch search both extensions, and added the 30 missing bundled icon assets (15 PNG + 15 lossless WebP, all 5 densities).
- **Removed two stale, dead patches.** `Disable AppMetrica` and `Disable MyTracker` had zero call sites anywhere in the codebase - fully superseded by the comprehensive `Disable analytics libraries`/`Disable analytics manifest components` patches. Their unique legacy pre-rename Yandex Metrica namespace bytecode logic was folded into the comprehensive patch before deletion, so no coverage was lost.
- **Critical: the AppMetrica/MyTracker tracking-disable patches were silently never running in any default build, on any of the 10 apps.** `dependsOn(patch)` only orders execution between patches that are *already independently enabled* - it does not force-enable a `default = false` dependency. Wiring `dependsOn(disableAnalyticsDependency)` into Avito's and RuStore's patches in an earlier release looked like it closed the AppMetrica/Varioqub gap, but empirical re-testing against fresh default-only builds showed the dependency was still being skipped (`Skipping disabled: ... (default)`) in every real build. Fixed by giving `Disable analytics libraries` and `Disable analytics manifest components` their own real per-app `Compatibility` entries (gated to all 10 apps) so the framework actually honors `default = true`, using the same technique already proven for `Bypass RootBeer root detection`. This also closes a previously-undetected gap: MAX's and Sberbank's MyTracker SDK was never being disabled in any shipped build.

All 10 apps rebuilt from fresh true originals against this release and re-verified (`apksigner verify`); default-only builds now show `Applied: Disable analytics libraries` / `Applied: Disable analytics manifest components` on every app instead of being silently skipped.
